name: OptionStatus
description:
The list's state above the options: a thin indeterminate line while results refresh
(the previous ones stay), skeleton rows on the first load, an error row with Retry, or
a prompt for more characters. Rows are exactly one option tall.
signature: ({ status, twoLine, needsMore, onRetry }: OptionStatusProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when retry occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: twoLine
props.description: Two-line rows: the skeleton matches them.
